Self-contained repro for the 2026-07-01 probe loop against dist 1.4.0. Recreate anywhere:

**Planted-bug file** (payment.js, commit a base version without refund(), then add):
```js
function refund(customer, amount) {
  if (amount = 0) {            // assignment-instead-of-comparison
    return null;
  }
  const balance = customer.balance;
  customer.balance = balance + amount;   // no negative-amount validation
  db.query(`UPDATE customers SET balance = ${customer.balance} WHERE id = '${customer.id}'`);  // SQL injection
  return customer.balance;
}
```
`git diff > probe.diff` (base file also carries a string-concat INSERT injection in chargeCustomer for two-provider agreement testing).

**Configs** (.reviewbridge.json variants):
- Normal deliberate-deep: `{"provider":"codex","codex_path":"/Users/amirshayegh/.local/bin/codex","mode":"deliberate-deep"}`
- Forced-degraded: `{"provider":"codex","codex_path":"/nonexistent/codex-binary-gone","mode":"deliberate"}`
- Gemini-primary: `{"provider":"gemini","mode":"deliberate"}`

**Probe sequence** (CLI = node dist/index.js, all with --json):
1. `review-code --diff probe.diff --config <degraded-cfg>` → expect deliberation.degraded={failed:codex, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE}, providers=[gemini], agreement='agree' (the ISS-016 mislabel), capture session_id.
2. `review-code --diff probe.diff --session <id> --config <degraded-cfg>` → ISS-011: hard PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, no failover to the healthy session owner.
3. `review-code --diff probe.diff --session <id> --config <gemini-cfg>` → ISS-010: succeeds, same session, deliberation block entirely absent.
4. Fresh deliberate-deep with BOTH providers live (needs Codex usage headroom) → ISS-013 data: compare agreed[] vs divergent[] on the planted bugs; capture category/line drift between providers.

CLI has no cross-provider guard (ISS-017) — probes 2/3 exercise the backend seam directly; the MCP path would reject at tracker preflight instead.

Observed 2026-07-01: Codex RATE_LIMITED (real usage limit, reset 5:27 PM) also produced a correct degraded marker — unplanned probe of failover eligibility, clean.
title: Deliberation probe kit (repro for ISS-010/011/013/016/017 live probes)
